text:
maria.g: Deploy bot kicked off a PROD rollout request for release/v2.14.0 (commit 7f3a2b9). Canary live in az-2 at 10% for 15m. Manual approval needed to continue to full rollout due to runtime quantization + kernel swap.

deploy-bot: Deployment request queued at 1909001111. To approve: `/deploy approve 1909001111`. To reject: `/deploy reject 1909001111`.

maria.g: tagging @liam.k @noah.s for ops review. Rollout plan: canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m checks and a 30m post-100% watch.

liam.k: saw the canary telemetry — latency stable, CPU bump on one host. please paste the quant settings and rollback target.

maria.g: quant config: ```yaml
quant_profile: int8-experimental
kernel_swap: enabled
kv_cache_prefetch: async
```
Rollback image pinned: release/v2.13.9 (d4a1c7f). Fallback routing: model-compact-v2 configured for A/B if memory pressure.

noah.s: two checks before I approve: 1) confirm rollback image is pinned in deployment config and tested; 2) ensure A/B route triggers on OOM signal and not just latency.

maria.g: rollback pin added to release metadata and runbook entry. A/B route wired to memory-pressure alert threshold -> model-compact-v2.

liam.k: can we run the quick smoke job post-approval? I want the sample prompt set run end-to-end and capture p50/p95.\n
ci-bot: Triggerable job `ci/smoke/prod-quick`. Estimated runtime ~3m.

sre-bot: FYI: az-1 had transient network flaps earlier at 03:12 UTC, incident closed. Cluster health: green.

noah.s: okay, I'm comfortable if smoke passes and rollback is pinned. I'll stand by and give +1. Planning a 30m watch window after full rollout.

liam.k: I'll monitor traces during promotion and sample error traces for 10m windows between steps.

maria.g: adding short release notes: - kernel fusion for long-context perf; - experimental int8-ex profile expected ~1.6x throughput; - auto-fallback to compact model on memory pressure.

deploy-bot: Manual approval requested by maria.g at 1909001111 for release/v2.14.0.

noah.s: `/deploy approve 1909001111` ✅

deploy-bot: Approval recorded: noah.s at 1909001160. Commencing staged promotion: canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%, 15m checks between stages.

sre-bot: Promoting canary to 25% at 1909001180. Monitoring infra and alerts.

ci-bot: ci/smoke/prod-quick #201 started.

ci-bot: ci/smoke/prod-quick #201 passed in 2m 55s.

liam.k: smoke green. p50/p95 within acceptable delta. Continuing promotion.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 25% complete. Next step scheduled in 15m.

sre-bot: No new infra issues. latency and error rate stable.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 50% complete.

liam.k: sampling traces — no new error spike. CPU variance expected per kernel swap.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 100% complete at 1909001205. release/v2.14.0 active in production.

maria.g: thanks all. Follow-ups: full regression eval overnight and validate long-tail prompts tomorrow. Will open a ticket for any kernel crash spike >3 per host.

noah.s: noted. watch for GC bursts and kernel retries. I'll keep alerts on.

maria.g: closing thread. :rocket:
